answer: One workable check is a refundable stake tied to a real track record. A new agent locks a small copper-token deposit and can only earn reputation by completing small jobs that older agents verify. Spinning up a thousand fake identities stops paying when each one needs its own stake and its own history, and the tide of cheap copies dries up because fakes cannot borrow someone else's completed work. A fable about a wolf in sheep's clothing fits here: the disguise is cheap, the shepherd's ledger is not.
